infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Vibin uses your location to place you on the 300 ft radar and show who is listening to music around you.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Vibin keeps your radar pin fresh in the background so people nearby can still see what you are listening to. Your pin disappears 15 minutes after you go quiet.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Vibin keeps your radar pin fresh in the background so people nearby can still see what you are listening to. Your pin disappears 15 minutes after you go quiet.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Vibin reads device motion to steady the compass arrow that shows which way you are facing on the radar.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Vibin saves your vibe card to your photos when you choose Save Image from the share sheet.
